integrity: Every finite count is supplied by an exhaustive standalone standard-library verifier; universal genus, point-count and functional-equation statements have separate proofs. No independent audit.
limitations: Exhaustive classification of 100 monic centered marked triples over F5 only; not an abstract curve-isomorphism census. Some prior literature and computational tables may contain equivalent results. Common elliptic factor is up to isogeny, not necessarily an elliptic quotient morphism.
title: Eleven Weil-isogeny spectra of centered Picard quartics over \(\mathbb F_5\)
